# apipbx_time_condition (Resource)

Sends calls to one destination while a time group matches and to another otherwise. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `match_type` (String) Destination while the group matches: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `name` (String)
- `no_match_type` (String) Destination otherwise: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `time_group_id` (String)

### Optional

- `match_id` (String) Id of that destination (not for hangup).
- `no_match_id` (String)
- `override` (String) none, match or no_match: force one branch whatever the time.
- `toggle_code` (String) 1-3 digits: dialling *28 and the code from an extension flips override between none and no_match (a day/night switch, which shows as drift).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `matches_now` (Boolean) Whether the time group matches at the moment of the last refresh (informational).
